dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Traumatic right medial rectus restriction from transient entrapment or edema associated with a medial orbital-wall (“blowout”) fracture

Alternative: Traumatic orbital hematoma or soft-tissue swelling causing restrictive diplopia

Alternative: Traumatic right oculomotor-nerve palsy with partial medial-rectus weakness

Alternative: Traumatic orbital fracture with extraocular-muscle contusion without entrapment
